* * *

## [Terrible defective item](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6313e4207f7a8621ee51de1b)
Terrible. As soon as the Puddle Mirror by Sarah Sherman Samuel was launched, I jumped at the opportunity to purchase the large size ($698). The mirror arrived roughly a week later, the frame completely warped and separated from the mirror (small bits of foam sat snug between). I was very disappointed, to say the least. I chose to share my product experience directly on the website, and they never posted my review (such a lack of transparency and dishonesty). I am requesting a full refund and for the company to be responsible for the shipment back to the warehouse. I have ordered a few other items from Lulu and G (2 dining tables), so perhaps manufacturing mirrors is just not their forte. Dissatisfied.

September 4, 2022

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Sep 6, 2022

Hi Christine,

We're so sorry to hear you are dissatisfied with the quality of your mirror. We see one of our representatives has assisted you with this return and we shared your feedback with the appropriate teams. If you'd like to share any additional feedback, please reach out to our Customer Experience team at support@luluandgeorgia.com.
